plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Art History AA-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 19, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7966/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61-62; lower bound 61 used = 15+15+15+16 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 Area 2 3-4 -> 3). ARTH 309 lists ENGL C1000 in the prerequisite column WITHOUT an 'Advisory:' label (in this map bare entries denote prerequisites, e.g. ART 304 requires ART 300, while advisories are explicitly labeled, e.g. ARTH 332 advisory ENGL C1000); it is therefore encoded as a prerequisite. ENGL C1000 is not sequenced in the map and is carried under external_prereqs. (Note: the Art History A.A. maps label the same preparation as advisory.) List A (minimum 3 units, must not duplicate already-taken courses): ART 301, ART 304 (requires ART 300), ART 320, ART 327 (advisory ART 300), ART 361, ART 372, ARTH 312, ARTH 328, ARTH 332 (advisory ENGL C1000), ARTH 333 — one 3-unit selection sequenced in Semester 2. Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation.
